concerns.text: T016 aggregates trend information and explicitly requires confidence intervals from T017 and correlation results from T018, but T016 is listed before T017 and T018, creating a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

The orchestrator script (T033) lists pipeline steps in the order T016 → T017 → T018, which mirrors the same consumer‑before‑producer issue: T016 depends on outputs of T017 and T018 that are scheduled later, violating the required execution order.

T007 is tagged [P] (parallel‑safe) yet it verifies the directory hierarchy created by T001; it inherently depends on T001 completing first, so it is not safe to run in parallel and the [P] tag is incorrect.
